descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S01 「医院，两台设备：登录、手机上添加、电脑上存查房前、手机上生成、电脑上删除」 Hospital, both devices: sign in, add on phone, pre-round save on computer, generate on phone, delete on computer

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in.（UAT TC-25 step 1；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 9；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry.（UAT TC-25 step 2；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything.（UAT TC-25 step 3；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 11；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U4 A note generated on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh.（UAT TC-25 step 4；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time.（UAT TC-25 step 5；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 18；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T1 Each device goes through its own email-code sign-in (a new device always asks for a code). The two do not share a session token, and both stay valid at once.（TFA-94513 AC 6；TFA-94513 AC 10；UAT TC-25 step 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician with {hospitalPatient} and {snfResident}, plus a second fresh @roundai.test physician ('other') left on its own Hospital list. Run order, so cp1 can see a sign-out: the computer's browser loads and shows the Hospital list first; …

When Phone adds 'QA Sync Hosp'. Computer types the pre-round text into {hospitalPatient}'s notes and taps Save Note while the phone has that chart open. Phone types the encounter text and taps Generate Note & Finish while the computer has the Post-Round tab open. …

Then The computer is still signed in after the phone's sign-in and a server round-trip. Each change shows on the other device without a refresh: the new card, the pre-round text and the panels Save Note filled (panels gated on Q5), the generated note, and the removed card gone. The other physician's list never shows any of it

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint (below); every observing-device checkpoint also has mustNotContain 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong' (the sign-in gate, AuthGate.tsx, and the crash screen, AppErrorBoundary.tsx, both have a button and no patient name). The session log shows no reload or navigation on the observing device between the change and its checkpoint. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
